account: It is day 0, shortly after 09:00. I have come from home to town hall and read the appointment book left by the secretary. Today's business is morning correspondence, a 10:00 market walk in the plaza, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea at an east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. Tomorrow includes a 10:00 grain inspection at the mill. The secretary is beside me holding a writable book. I asked what correspondence needs attention and which cottage hosts tea, but have heard no answer yet. Several townsfolk have passed or gathered near the hall; I have not heard their business. I returned the appointment book to its chest. Nothing I have actually seen or heard establishes any unusual event, dispute, or hidden purpose today. The appointments appear to be ordinary town administration and social visits; I still need to learn the town's news and clarify the tea destination.
